items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: So that's why when I first seen my brother play trap drum, it was with Old Man Lindsey playing... Johnny Lindsey on bass... And he made me play something there with Old Man... That's the break me and Buddy Johnson... I went with him several times

ctx.x: And who did he play with?

Whose bands? Well at that time, that's a fellow that you don't know anything about, and very few people talk about that. His first bunch, I remember good, I was in these pants, used to wear bloomer pants. They said, they're playing with Old Man Lindsey now. Old Man Lindsey. Old Man Lindsey. Old Man Lindsey had a string orchestra in the family. Horven Lindsey, and Old Man Lindsey, and Johnny Lindsey. You see? Then they add on. They had a fan on my brother. I remember that good.
